description: Everything about ONE domain in a single call. Use this when you need to profile one company or website end to end (sales research, vendor or security review, due diligence). For several domains or only one aspect, use email_security, tech_stack or domain_registration instead (cheaper and faster). Input: domain (a domain, URL or email address). Returns check and results[0] with reachable, finalUrl, statusCode, title, description and language of the homepage; technologies[] (CMS, e-commerce, frameworks, analytics, CDN…, each with the evidence it was detected from); email (MX provider, SPF and DMARC policy); dns records and verification tokens; securityHeaders; registration (RDAP registrar, created and expiry dates, age); files (robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, security.txt); a one-line summary, analyzedAt and cached. exists tells whether the domain resolves; a site that blocks bots is flagged blocked=true. Limits: each domain counts as one lookup; answers cached for 1 hour per domain; 25 free domains a day per IP without a key, more with a paid key in the x-api-key header. Read-only: nothing is stored, no email is sent.

domain.description: One domain, URL or email address, e.g. stripe.com, https://stripe.com/pricing or ops@stripe.com (the domain part is used)
